title: Creamy Mac and Cheese
description: A comforting and creamy macaroni pasta dish that is perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Cook the macaroni in a large pot of boiling salted water until it's al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook until they're softened and lightly browned.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the cheddar cheese until it's fully melted and the sauce is smooth.
Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese sauce and stir until it's well coated.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a baking dish and top with the flaky pastry.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the mac and cheese is heated through.
